# Friendship Problem-Solving Mini Script

Subject: SEL and Advisory
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Conversation Script
NYS framework label: NYS SEL Benchmarks and local advisory goals

## Short Description
A short script that helps students name the problem, listen, suggest options, and repair harm.

## Alignment Note
Supports relationship skills, responsible decision-making, and restorative classroom routines.

## Classroom Use Case
Keep in a calm corner, counselor space, or classroom meeting folder.

## Preview Content
- I noticed
- I felt
- Next time we can

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
